summary: White Mountains Insurance Group filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary HG Global completed a private placement of $200 million 7.39% senior secured notes due 2036. Proceeds will repay an existing floating-rate $150 million term loan (9.93%), pay fees, and fund a dividend. This is a routine refinancing of subsidiary debt, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The filing describes entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation, but no change of control, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. No special situation classification applies.
